paragraphs: A four-year study tracking over 1,200 men in Utah has revealed that breathing in common air pollutants like ozone and nitrogen dioxide can negatively affect their reproductive health.

The research shows that exposure to these man-made contaminants during sperm development is linked to subtle DNA changes. Specifically, it affects a process called methylation, which acts like a switch turning genes on and off. Experts warn that these changes can lead to decreased sperm counts and lower motility, which is the sperm’s ability to swim. Because these pollutants come from heavy industrial activity and busy city traffic fumes, men living in larger, highly polluted cities face a greater risk of fertility issues.

These genetic changes inside the testes can have long-term consequences not only for the individual’s fertility but also for their future children. To protect themselves, people are advised to reduce unnecessary exposure by wearing face masks during heavy smog or taking occasional trips out of the city.

paragraphs: A new four-year study shows that dirty air can hurt male fertility. Scientists studied more than 1,200 men and found that breathing in common city pollution causes small changes in sperm DNA.

These changes affect genes and can make it harder for men to have children. The biggest problems come from ozone and nitrogen dioxide, which are dangerous gases from cars and factories. Because of this, men who live in big, busy cities often have a lower sperm count, and their sperm cannot swim well. This is a serious problem because these changes can also affect the health of future babies.

Experts say it is difficult for everyone to leave the city, but men can protect themselves. They can lead a healthy lifestyle, wear face masks when there is a lot of smog, and visit nature outside the city.

paragraphs: Dirty air from cars and factories can be bad for men. A new study looks at 1,200 men over four years. Scientists find that bad air changes sperm. These changes can stop men from having babies.
Men who live in big, busy cities breathe in bad smoke every day. This smoke makes their bodies weaker. Their sperm is not so good. This is a big problem for their future children, too.
It is not easy to move away from big cities. But men can wear face masks when the air is very dirty. It also helps to eat good food and walk in the forest sometimes.
